data.notes: December 2026 is centered on Saint-Jean beach-club programming and New Year’s week, with confirmed international electronic headliners at Gyp Sea, La Guérite and Nikki Beach.

events.title: David Guetta at La Guérite Beach
events.summary: La Guérite’s year-end festival program lists David Guetta for December 28, one of the headline electronic dates of St. Barth’s festive week.

events.title: Peggy Gou at Super Island New Year’s Eve
events.summary: Peggy Gou headlines Gyp Sea Beach on New Year’s Eve as part of Super Island, the Indie Beach × Gyp Sea festive-week takeover.

events.title: Black Coffee at Super Island
events.summary: Black Coffee headlines Gyp Sea Beach for Super Island, bringing an Afro-house and deep-house set to Saint-Jean Bay.

events.title: RÜFÜS DU SOL DJ Set at La Guérite Beach
events.summary: La Guérite’s New Year’s Eve program lists RÜFÜS DU SOL for a DJ set on December 31 at its Saint-Jean beach venue.

events.title: Adriatique at La Guérite Beach
events.summary: Adriatique are listed for La Guérite Beach on December 29 as part of the venue’s New Year’s week run on Saint-Jean beach.

events.title: ANOTR at La Guérite Beach
events.summary: ANOTR are confirmed in La Guérite’s published festive-week schedule for December 30, adding a groove-led house night before New Year’s Eve.

events.title: Super Island: Indie Beach × Gyp Sea
events.summary: A seven-day beach-club takeover on Saint-Jean Bay by Indie Beach and Gyp Sea, positioning Gyp Sea as one of the island’s core festive-week dance destinations with WhoMadeWho, Black Coffee, Peggy Gou and Miguelle & Tons announced across the run.

events.title: La Guérite Beach New Year’s Eve: RÜFÜS DU SOL DJ Set
events.summary: RÜFÜS DU SOL are listed for a December 31 DJ set at La Guérite, making this one of Saint-Barth’s most in-demand electronic-music New Year’s Eve beach-club bookings.

events.title: HUGEL at Nikki Beach Saint Barth
events.summary: Bandsintown lists HUGEL at Nikki Beach in Gustavia on December 31, 2026, for a New Year’s Eve house and Latin-house beach-club event.

events.title: New Year’s Eve 2026 at Gyp Sea Beach: Peggy Gou
events.summary: Peggy Gou headlines Gyp Sea Beach’s New Year’s Eve party as part of the Super Island takeover, marking one of the island’s key house/electronic beach-club nights for the December 31 run-in to 2027.

events.title: WhoMadeWho at Super Island
events.summary: WhoMadeWho opens Super Island at Gyp Sea Beach with a hybrid DJ set on the first night of the Indie Beach × Gyp Sea week-long festival.

events.title: Nikki Beach Saint Barth New Year’s Eve: HUGEL
events.summary: HUGEL is confirmed at Nikki Beach Saint Barth on December 31, offering a Latin-house and tech-house-leaning alternative within the Saint-Jean NYE beach-club circuit.
